mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4.5% in the month prior to the prediction is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discounting of future cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% in the preceding month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, p > 0.05

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 5% for two consecutive months, labor market strength is expected to boost corporate earnings growth, driving a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 2% predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals weakening domestic demand for equities.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in at least 70% of INDPRO declines > 2%

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% for two consecutive months, supply-side pressures are expected to depress equity valuations, producing a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3% and remains above for next month
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is not negative when CPIAUCSL > 3% for two months

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the GDP deflator price index (not directly available, but as a proxy use GDPC1 growth) for three months followed by a rise in the 20-day S&P 500 forward return signals a shift from deflationary to growth-oriented monetary policy.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth remains negative for >6 months, or 20-day returns show no improvement

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor force participation (implied via HOUST) above 62 million for the next month is associated with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals demographic expansion and consumer demand growth.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses above 62 million in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when HOUST > 62 million

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in retail sales (implied via PAYEMS) of over 2% predict a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as it reflects strengthening consumer demand.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS grows by >2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS growth >2% for two months

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above their respective 2023 Q4 averages increases the probability of a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return through dual demand-supply amplification.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when both UNRATE < 4.5% and INDPRO > 105 over the same period
